title: Act: Use Button, Lucide ChevronUp and motion.aside in GameLayout
summary: Wire Lucide and Motion into GameLayout
description: Install lucide-react and motion and update GameLayout.
acceptance_criteria: Given GameLayout, when rendered, then toggle is Button with icon
Given the aside, when rendered, then it is a motion.aside with unchanged classes

steps.action: Add lucide-react ^0.441.0 and motion ^11.11.0 to dependencies and run npm install

Import Button from './ui/button', ChevronUp from 'lucide-react', motion from 'motion/react'. Replace <aside> with <motion.aside> keeping the className expression; replace <button> with <Button type='button' variant='ghost' ...same aria-expanded and onClick> whose children are <ChevronUp aria-hidden='true' className='h-4 w-4' /> then the text Story
steps.code: <Button type="button" variant="ghost" aria-expanded={drawerOpen} onClick={...}><ChevronUp aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />Story</Button>
steps.expected: Existing layout tests still pass and the toggle contains an svg
